武平七年十二月／德昌元年

units.zh: 李稚廉 封述 許惇 羊烈 源彪
units.en: Li Zhilian; Feng Shu; Xu Dun; Yang Lie; Yuan Biao
units.literal: Li Zhilian; Feng Shu; Xu Dun; Yang Lie; Yuan Biao

units.zh: 李稚廉，趙郡高邑人也。
units.en: Li Zhilian came from Gaoyi in Zhao commandery.
units.literal: Li Zhilian, a man of Gaoyi in Zhao commandery.

units.zh: 齊州刺史義深之弟。
units.en: He was the younger brother of Yishen, inspector of Qi province.
units.literal: Younger brother of Yishen, inspector of Qi province.

units.zh: 稚廉少而寡欲，為兒童時，初不從家人有所求請。
units.en: Zhilian from youth was sparing in desire; as a child he would not ask his family for anything.
units.literal: Zhilian from youth was few in desires; as a child he would not at first ask anything of his family.

units.zh: 家人嘗故以金寶授之，終不取，強付，輒擲之於地。
units.en: His family once deliberately gave him gold and jewels; he never took them, and when they forced them on him he threw them to the ground.
units.literal: His family once deliberately gave him gold and jewels; he never took them, and when they forced payment he would throw them to the ground.

units.zh: 州牧以其蒙稚而廉，故名曰稚廉。
units.en: The provincial governor, because he was young and yet frugal, gave him the name Zhilian.
units.literal: The provincial governor, because he was young and yet frugal, therefore named him Zhilian.

units.zh: 聰敏好學，年十五，頗尋覽五經章句。
units.en: Clever and fond of learning, at fifteen he had already worked through the chapter-and-commentary texts of the Five Classics.
units.literal: Clever and fond of learning; at fifteen he had already gone through the chapter-and-commentary texts of the Five Classics.

units.zh: 屬葛榮作亂，本郡紛擾，違難赴京。
units.en: When Ge Rong rose in rebellion the native commandery was in turmoil; he fled the troubles and went to the capital.
units.literal: When Ge Rong rose in rebellion the native commandery was in turmoil; he fled the disaster and went to the capital.

units.zh: 永安中，釋褐奉朝請。
units.en: In the Yong'an era he left private life and was made court gentleman attendant.
units.literal: In the Yong'an era he doffed commoner's dress and was made court gentleman attendant.

units.zh: 普泰初，開府記室、龍驤將軍、廣州征南府錄事參軍，不行。
units.en: Early in Putai he was made establishment-office recorder, dragon-prancing general, and recorder in the Guangzhou expeditionary-south establishment office, but did not take office.
units.literal: Early in Putai he was made establishment-office recorder, dragon-prancing general, and recorder in the Guangzhou expeditionary-south establishment office; he did not take office.

units.zh: 尋轉開府諮議參軍事、前將軍。
units.en: Soon he was transferred to consulting aide in the establishment office and former general.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to consulting aide in the establishment office and former general.

units.zh: 天平中，高祖擢為泰州開府長史、平北將軍。
units.en: In the Tianping era Gao Huan promoted him to chief of staff in the Taizhou establishment office and general who pacifies the north.
units.literal: In the Tianping era Gao Huan promoted him to chief of staff in the Taizhou establishment office and general who pacifies the north.

units.zh: 稚廉緝諧將士，軍民樂悅。
units.en: Zhilian harmonized officers and men, and army and people were pleased.
units.literal: Zhilian harmonized officers and men; army and people were pleased.

units.zh: 高祖頻幸河東，大相嗟賞。
units.en: Gao Huan frequently visited Hedong and greatly admired him, praising him aloud.
units.literal: Gao Huan frequently visited Hedong and greatly admired him in sighs of praise.

units.zh: 轉為世宗驃騎府長史。
units.en: He was transferred to chief of staff in Gao Cheng's swift-cavalry establishment office.
units.literal: He was transferred to chief of staff in Gao Cheng's swift-cavalry establishment office.

units.zh: 詔以濟州控帶川陸，接對梁使，尤須得人，世宗薦之，除濟州儀同長史。
units.en: An edict said that because Jizhou controlled rivers and roads and received Liang envoys, an especially capable man was needed. Gao Cheng recommended him, and he was made acting chief of staff in Jizhou with insignia equal to the three excellencies.
units.literal: An edict said that because Jizhou controlled rivers and roads and received Liang envoys, an especially capable man was needed; Gao Cheng recommended him, and he was made acting chief of staff in Jizhou with insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 又遷瀛州長史。
units.en: He was again moved to chief of staff in Ying province.
units.literal: He was again moved to chief of staff in Ying province.

units.zh: 高祖行經冀州，總合河北六州文籍，商校戶口增損。
units.en: Gao Huan was passing through Ji province and gathered the documents of the six Hebei provinces to compare and verify increases and decreases in household registers.
units.literal: Gao Huan was passing through Ji province and gathered the documents of the six Hebei provinces to compare and verify increases and decreases in household registers.

units.zh: 高祖親自部分，多在馬上，徵責文簿，指景取備，事緒非一。
units.en: Gao Huan personally directed the work, mostly on horseback, demanding documents and pointing to scenes to require completeness—affairs of many kinds.
units.literal: Gao Huan personally directed the work, mostly on horseback, demanding documents and pointing to scenes to require completeness—affairs of many kinds.

units.zh: 稚廉每應機立成，恒先期會，莫不雅合深旨，為諸州準的。
units.en: Zhilian each time responded on the spot and finished at once, always meeting the deadline in advance; nothing failed to match the deep intent, and he became the standard for all provinces.
units.literal: Zhilian each time responded on the spot and finished at once, always meeting the deadline in advance; nothing failed to match the deep intent, and he became the standard for all provinces.

units.zh: 高祖顧謂司馬子如曰：「觀稚廉處分，快人意也。」
units.en: Gao Huan turned to Sima Ziru and said, "Watch how Zhilian disposes affairs—it satisfies the mind."
units.literal: Gao Huan turned to Sima Ziru and said: "Watch how Zhilian disposes affairs—it satisfies the mind."

units.zh: 因集文武數萬人，令郎中杜弼宣旨慰勞，仍詰諸州長史、守令等，諸人並謝罪，稚廉獨前拜恩，觀者咸歎美之。
units.en: He then gathered civil and military officials numbering tens of thousands, had gentleman Du Bi proclaim the edict to comfort and reward them, and still questioned the chiefs of staff, magistrates, and the rest of the provinces. All others bowed in confession of fault, but Zhilian alone stepped forward to bow in thanks for grace, and the onlookers all sighed in admiration.
units.literal: He then gathered civil and military officials numbering tens of thousands, had gentleman Du Bi proclaim the edict to comfort and reward them, and still questioned the chiefs of staff, magistrates, and the rest of the provinces; all others bowed in confession of fault, but Zhilian alone stepped forward to bow in thanks for grace, and the onlookers all sighed in admiration.

units.zh: 其日，賜以牛酒。
units.en: That day he was granted oxen and wine.
units.literal: That day he was granted oxen and wine.

units.zh: 高祖還幷，以其事告世宗。
units.en: Gao Huan returned to Bing and told Gao Cheng of the affair.
units.literal: Gao Huan returned to Bing and told Gao Cheng of the affair.

units.zh: 世宗喜而語人曰：「吾足知人矣。」
units.en: Gao Cheng was pleased and told others, "I am quite able to know men."
units.literal: Gao Cheng was pleased and told others: "I am quite able to know men."

units.zh: 世宗嗣事，召詣晉陽，除霸府掾。
units.en: When Gao Cheng took up affairs he summoned Zhilian to Jinyang and made him a staff member of the hegemon's office.
units.literal: When Gao Cheng took up affairs he summoned Zhilian to Jinyang and made him a staff member of the hegemon's office.

units.zh: 謂杜弼曰：「幷州王者之基，須好長史，各舉所知。」
units.en: He told Du Bi, "Bingzhou is the king's foundation; a good chief of staff is needed—each of you recommend someone you know."
units.literal: He told Du Bi: "Bingzhou is the king's foundation; a good chief of staff is needed—each of you recommend someone you know."

units.zh: 時互有所稱，皆不允。
units.en: At the time each recommended someone else; none was approved.
units.literal: At the time each recommended someone else; none was approved.

units.zh: 衆人未答。
units.en: The crowd had not yet answered.
units.literal: The crowd had not yet answered.

units.zh: 世宗乃謂陳元康曰：「我教君好長史處，李稚廉卽其人也。」
units.en: Gao Cheng then told Chen Yuankang, "I will teach you where to find a good chief of staff—Li Zhilian is the man."
units.literal: Gao Cheng then told Chen Yuankang: "I will teach you where to find a good chief of staff—Li Zhilian is the man."

units.zh: 遂命為幷州長史。
units.en: He then appointed him chief of staff in Bing province.
units.literal: He then appointed him chief of staff in Bing province.

units.zh: 常在世宗第內，與隴西辛術等六人號為館客，待以上賓之禮。
units.en: He was constantly within Gao Cheng's residence, and with Xin Shu of Longxi and five others was called lodge guests, treated with the courtesy due a superior guest.
units.literal: He was constantly within Gao Cheng's residence, and with Xin Shu of Longxi and five others was called lodge guests, treated with the courtesy due a superior guest.

units.zh: 天保初，除安南將軍、太原郡守。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianbao, he was appointed general who pacifies the south and administrator of Taiyuan commandery.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, he was appointed general who pacifies the south and administrator of Taiyuan commandery.

units.zh: 顯祖嘗召見，問以治方，語及政刑寬猛，帝意深文峻法，稚廉固以為非，帝意不悅。
units.en: Xianzu once summoned him and asked about methods of governance. When the conversation turned to lenient versus severe policy and punishment, the emperor favored harsh statutory interpretation and severe laws. Zhilian firmly objected, and the emperor was displeased.
units.literal: Xianzu once summoned him and asked about methods of governance. When the conversation reached whether government and punishments should be lenient or severe, the emperor favored harsh statutory interpretation and severe laws; Zhilian firmly thought this wrong, and the emperor was displeased.

units.zh: 語及楊愔，誤稱為楊公。
units.en: When Yang Yin came up, he mistakenly called him Duke Yang.
units.literal: When the discussion reached Yang Yin, he mistakenly called him Duke Yang.

units.zh: 以應對失宜，除濟陰郡守，帶西兗州刺史。
units.en: Because his replies were inappropriate, he was sent out as administrator of Jiyin commandery and concurrently inspector of Western Yanzhou.
units.literal: Because his replies were inappropriate, he was appointed administrator of Jiyin commandery and concurrently inspector of Western Yanzhou.

units.zh: 徵拜太府少卿，尋轉廷尉少卿，遷太尉長史。
units.en: He was summoned as vice director of the Imperial Storehouse, soon transferred to vice director of the Court of Judicatory, and then became chief clerk of the Grand Commandant.
units.literal: He was summoned and appointed vice director of the Imperial Storehouse, soon transferred to vice director of the Court of Judicatory, and then moved to chief clerk of the Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 肅宗卽位，兼散騎常侍、省方大使。
units.en: When Suzong ascended, he concurrently served as scattered cavalry regular attendant and grand commissioner for regional inspection.
units.literal: When Suzong ascended the throne, he concurrently served as scattered cavalry regular attendant and grand commissioner for regional inspection.

units.zh: 行還，所奏多見納用。
units.en: When he returned from the inspection, many of his memorials were accepted and put into effect.
units.literal: When he returned from the journey, many of the things he memorialized were accepted and put to use.

units.zh: 除合州刺史，亦有政績。
units.en: He was appointed inspector of Hezhou and also had achievements in governance.
units.literal: He was appointed inspector of Hezhou and also had achievements in governance.

units.zh: 未滿，行懷州刺史。
units.en: Before his term was complete, he acted as inspector of Huaizhou.
units.literal: Before his term was complete, he acted as inspector of Huaizhou.

units.zh: 還朝，授兼太仆卿，轉大司農卿、趙州大中正。
units.en: On returning to court, he was appointed concurrently grand minister of studs and transferred to chief minister of the Grand Granary and grand rectifier of Zhaozhou.
units.literal: Returning to court, he was appointed concurrently grand minister of studs and transferred to chief minister of the Grand Granary and grand rectifier of Zhaozhou.

units.zh: 天統元年，加驃騎大將軍、大理卿，世稱平直。
units.en: In the first year of Tiantong, he was additionally made grand general of agile cavalry and director of the great court of justice, and people of the time called him fair and upright.
units.literal: In the first year of Tiantong, he was additionally made grand general of agile cavalry and director of the great court of justice; the age called him fair and upright.

units.zh: 為南青州刺史，未幾，征為幷省都官尚書。
units.en: He served as inspector of Southern Qingzhou and, before long, was summoned as director of punishments in the Bing provincial department.
units.literal: He served as inspector of Southern Qingzhou; before long, he was summoned as director of punishments in the Bing provincial department.

units.zh: 武平五年三月，卒於晉陽，年六十七。
units.en: In the third month of the fifth year of Wuping, he died at Jinyang at the age of sixty-seven.
units.literal: In the third month of the fifth year of Wuping, he died at Jinyang, aged sixty-seven.

units.zh: 贈儀同三司、信義二州刺史、吏部尚書。
units.en: He was posthumously presented as ceremonial equal to the three offices, inspector of Xin and Yi provinces, and Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: He was posthumously presented as ceremonial equal to the three offices, inspector of Xin and Yi provinces, and Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 封述，字君義，渤海蓨人也。
units.en: Feng Shu, styled Junyi, came from Tiao in Bohai.
units.literal: Feng Shu, styled Junyi, was a man of Tiao in Bohai.

units.zh: 父軌，廷尉卿、濟州刺史。
units.en: His father Gui was director of the court of justice and inspector of Ji province.
units.literal: His father Gui was director of the court of justice and inspector of Ji province.

units.zh: 述有幹用，年十八為濟州征東府鎧曹參軍。
units.en: Shu had administrative ability; at eighteen he was armor-bureau aide in the Ji province expeditionary-east establishment office.
units.literal: Shu had administrative ability; at eighteen he was armor-bureau aide in the Ji province expeditionary-east establishment office.

units.zh: 高道穆為御史中尉，啟為御史。
units.en: Gao Daomu was attendant censor-in-chief and opened a post for him as censor.
units.literal: Gao Daomu was attendant censor-in-chief and opened a post for him as censor.

units.zh: 遷大司馬清河王開府記室參軍，兼司徒主簿。
units.en: He was moved to recorder in Prince of Qinghe's grand-marshal establishment office, concurrently chief clerk in the ministry of the masses.
units.literal: He was moved to recorder in Prince of Qinghe's grand-marshal establishment office, concurrently chief clerk in the ministry of the masses.

units.zh: 太昌中，除尚書三公郎中，以平幹稱。
units.en: In the Taichang era he was made gentleman in the ministry of the three excellencies; he was known as fair and capable.
units.literal: In the Taichang era he was made gentleman in the ministry of the three excellencies; he was known as fair and capable.

units.zh: 天平中，增損舊事為《麟趾新格》，其名法科條，皆述刪定。
units.en: In the Tianping era he revised old precedents into the New Statutes of the Linzhi Hall; its legal articles and clauses were all edited and fixed by Shu.
units.literal: In the Tianping era he revised old precedents into the New Statutes of the Linzhi Hall; its legal articles and clauses were all edited and fixed by Shu.

units.zh: 梁散騎常侍陸晏子、沈警來聘，以述兼通直郎使梁。
units.en: Liang scattered-cavalry regular attendant Lu Yanzi and Shen Jing came on embassy; Shu was made concurrent direct-communication gentleman and sent to Liang.
units.literal: Liang scattered-cavalry regular attendant Lu Yanzi and Shen Jing came on embassy; Shu was made concurrent direct-communication gentleman and sent to Liang.

units.zh: 還，遷世宗大將軍府從事中郎，監京畿事。
units.en: On return he was moved to aide in Gao Cheng's great-general establishment office and overseer of capital-district affairs.
units.literal: On return he was moved to aide in Gao Cheng's great-general establishment office and overseer of capital-district affairs.

units.zh: 武定五年，除彭城太守、當郡督，再行東徐州刺史。
units.en: In the fifth Wuding year he was made administrator of Pengcheng and supervisor of that commandery, and again acting inspector of eastern Xuzhou.
units.literal: In the fifth Wuding year he was made administrator of Pengcheng and supervisor of that commandery, and again acting inspector of eastern Xuzhou.

units.zh: 武定七年，除廷尉少卿。
units.en: In the seventh Wuding year he was made vice director of the court of justice.
units.literal: In the seventh Wuding year he was made vice director of the court of justice.

units.zh: 八年，兼給事黃門侍郎。
units.en: In the eighth year he was concurrently supervising gentleman of the yellow gate.
units.literal: In the eighth year he was concurrently supervising gentleman of the yellow gate.

units.zh: 齊受禪，與李獎等八人充大使，巡省方俗，問民疾苦。
units.en: When Qi received the mandate he, with Li Jiang and seven others, served as great envoys touring the regions to inquire into local customs and ask after the people's hardships.
units.literal: When Qi received the mandate he, with Li Jiang and seven others, served as great envoys touring the regions to inquire into local customs and ask after the people's hardships.

units.zh: 天保三年，除清河太守，遷司徒左長史，行東都事，尋除海州刺史。
units.en: In the third Tianbao year he was made administrator of Qinghe, moved to left chief of staff in the ministry of the masses, acting director of eastern-capital affairs, and soon made inspector of Haizhou.
units.literal: In the third Tianbao year he was made administrator of Qinghe, moved to left chief of staff in the ministry of the masses, acting director of eastern-capital affairs, and soon made inspector of Haizhou.

units.zh: 大寧元年，徵授大理卿。
units.en: In the first Daning year he was summoned and appointed director of the great court of justice.
units.literal: In the first Daning year he was summoned and appointed director of the great court of justice.

units.zh: 河清三年，勑與錄尚書趙彥深、僕射魏收、尚書陽休之、國子祭酒馬敬德等議定律令。
units.en: In the third Heqing year an edict ordered him together with recorder of the masters of writing Zhao Yanshen, vice director Wei Shou, minister Yang Xiuzhi, and director of the imperial academy Ma Jingde and others to deliberate on laws and ordinances.
units.literal: In the third Heqing year an edict ordered him together with recorder of the masters of writing Zhao Yanshen, vice director Wei Shou, minister Yang Xiuzhi, and director of the imperial academy Ma Jingde and others to deliberate on laws and ordinances.

units.zh: 天統元年，遷度支尚書。
units.en: In the first Tiantong year he was moved to director of the revenue ministry.
units.literal: In the first Tiantong year he was moved to director of the revenue ministry.

units.zh: 三年，轉五兵尚書，加儀同三司。
units.en: In the third year he was transferred to director of the five armies ministry and given added rank as acting insignia equal to the three excellencies.
units.literal: In the third year he was transferred to director of the five armies ministry and given added rank as acting insignia equal to the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 武平元年，除南兗州刺史。
units.en: In the first Wuping year he was made inspector of southern Yanzhou.
units.literal: In the first Wuping year he was made inspector of southern Yanzhou.

units.zh: 更滿還朝，除左光祿大夫，又除殿中尚書。
units.en: When his term ended he returned to court and was made left grand master of gleaming fortune, then again director in the palace ministry.
units.literal: When his term ended he returned to court and was made left grand master of gleaming fortune, then again director in the palace ministry.

units.zh: 述久為法官，明解律令，議斷平允，深為時人所稱。
units.en: Shu long served as a judicial officer, clearly understanding statutes and ordinances; his deliberations and judgments were fair and even, and he was deeply praised by men of the time.
units.literal: Shu long served as a judicial officer, clearly understanding statutes and ordinances; his deliberations and judgments were fair and even, and he was deeply praised by men of the time.

units.zh: 而厚積財產，一無饋遺，雖至親密友貧病困篤，亦絕於拯濟，朝野物論甚鄙之。
units.en: Yet he amassed wealth in great store and made not a single gift; even to the closest friends, when poor, ill, and in desperate straits, he cut off all relief—court and countryside alike in public talk greatly despised him.
units.literal: Yet he amassed wealth in great store and made not a single gift; even to the closest friends, when poor, ill, and in desperate straits, he cut off all relief—court and countryside alike in public talk greatly despised him.

units.zh: 外貌方整而不免請謁，迴避進趨，頗致嗤駭。
units.en: Outwardly his appearance was square and orderly, yet he could not avoid private petitions; in avoiding and advancing he often drew sneers of shock.
units.literal: Outwardly his appearance was square and orderly, yet he could not avoid private petitions; in avoiding and advancing he often drew sneers of shock.

units.zh: 前妻河內司馬氏，一息，為娶隴西李士元女，大輸財娉。
units.en: His former wife was of the Sima clan of Henei; he had one son, for whom he took in marriage the daughter of Li Shiyuan of Longxi and lavished bride-price wealth.
units.literal: His former wife was of the Sima clan of Henei; he had one son, for whom he took in marriage the daughter of Li Shiyuan of Longxi and lavished bride-price wealth.

units.zh: 及將成禮，猶競懸違。
units.en: When the rites were about to be completed they still disputed and hung in delay.
units.literal: When the rites were about to be completed they still disputed and hung in delay.

units.zh: 述忽取供養像對士元打像作誓，士元笑曰：「封公何處常得應急像，須誓便用。」
units.en: Shu suddenly took an offering image and faced Shiyuan, striking the image to swear; Shiyuan laughed and said, "Lord Feng, where do you always get emergency images, that you need a vow and use one at once?"
units.literal: Shu suddenly took an offering image and faced Shiyuan, striking the image to swear; Shiyuan laughed and said: "Lord Feng, where do you always get emergency images, that you need a vow and use one at once?"

units.zh: 一息娶范陽盧莊之女。
units.en: His son took in marriage the daughter of Lu Zhuangzhi of Fanyang.
units.literal: His son took in marriage the daughter of Lu Zhuangzhi of Fanyang.

units.zh: 述又逕府訴云：「送驘乃嫌腳跛，評田則云鹹薄，銅器又嫌古廢。」
units.en: Shu again went straight to the government office to complain, saying, "The mules sent were faulted as lame in the leg; when fields were appraised they were said to be salty and thin; bronze vessels too were faulted as old and worn out."
units.literal: Shu again went straight to the government office to complain, saying: "The mules sent were faulted as lame in the leg; when fields were appraised they were said to be salty and thin; bronze vessels too were faulted as old and worn out."

units.zh: 皆為吝嗇所及，每致紛紜。
units.en: All were matters touched by his stinginess, and each time brought turmoil.
units.literal: All were matters touched by his stinginess, and each time brought turmoil.

units.zh: 子元，武平末太子舍人。
units.en: His son Yuan, at the end of Wuping, was crown-prince attendant.
units.literal: His son Yuan, at the end of Wuping, was crown-prince attendant.

units.zh: 述弟詢，字景文。
units.en: Shu's younger brother Xun, styled Jingwen.
units.literal: Shu's younger brother Xun, styled Jingwen.

units.zh: 魏員外郎，武定中永安公開府法曹，稍遷尚書起部郎中，轉三公郎，出為東平原郡太守，遷定州長史，又除河間郡守，入為尚書左丞，又為濟南太守。
units.en: Wei outer-office gentleman; in Wuding he was law-bureau aide in Prince of Yong'an's establishment office, gradually moved to gentleman in the ministry of works' establishment section, transferred to gentleman of the three excellencies, went out as administrator of eastern Pingyuan commandery, moved to chief of staff in Ding province, again made administrator of Hejian commandery, entered court as left director in the masters of writing, and again administrator of Jinan.
units.literal: Wei outer-office gentleman; in Wuding he was law-bureau aide in Prince of Yong'an's establishment office, gradually moved to gentleman in the ministry of works' establishment section, transferred to gentleman of the three excellencies, went out as administrator of eastern Pingyuan commandery, moved to chief of staff in Ding province, again made administrator of Hejian commandery, entered court as left director in the masters of writing, and again administrator of Jinan.

units.zh: 隋開皇中卒。
units.en: He died in the Kaihuang era of Sui.
units.literal: He died in the Kaihuang era of Sui.

units.zh: 詢闚涉經史，清素自持，歷官皆有幹局才具，治郡甚著聲績，民吏敬而愛之。
units.en: Xun ranged through the classics and histories, held himself in pure simplicity, and in every office had administrative talent and equipment; in governing commanderies his reputation and achievement were very marked, and officials and people respected and loved him.
units.literal: Xun ranged through the classics and histories, held himself in pure simplicity, and in every office had administrative talent and equipment; in governing commanderies his reputation and achievement were very marked, and officials and people respected and loved him.

units.zh: 許惇，字季良，高陽新城人也。
units.en: Xu Dun, styled Jiliang, came from Xincheng in Gaoyang.
units.literal: Xu Dun, styled Jiliang, was a man of Xincheng in Gaoyang.

units.zh: 父護，魏高陽、章武二郡太守。
units.en: His father Hu was Wei administrator of Gaoyang and Zhangwu commanderies.
units.literal: His father Hu was Wei administrator of Gaoyang and Zhangwu commanderies.

units.zh: 惇清識敏速，達於從政，任司徒主簿，以能判斷見知，時人號為入鐵主簿。
units.en: Dun had clear judgment and quick wit, skilled in government; he served as chief clerk in the ministry of the masses and was known for his ability to decide cases; men of the time called him the Iron-Entering Registrar.
units.literal: Dun had clear judgment and quick wit, skilled in government; he served as chief clerk in the ministry of the masses and was known for his ability to decide cases; men of the time called him the Iron-Entering Registrar.

units.zh: 稍遷陽平太守。
units.en: He was gradually moved to administrator of Yangping.
units.literal: He was gradually moved to administrator of Yangping.

units.zh: 當時遷都鄴，陽平卽是畿郡，軍國責辦，賦斂無準，又勳貴屬請，朝夕徵求，惇並御之以道，上下無怨，治為下天第一。
units.en: At the time the capital was moved to Ye; Yangping was then a metropolitan commandery, and military and state requisitions and tax levies had no standard; moreover meritorious nobles made requests, seeking day and night—Dun governed all by principle, above and below without resentment, and his governance ranked first under Heaven.
units.literal: At the time the capital was moved to Ye; Yangping was then a metropolitan commandery, and military and state requisitions and tax levies had no standard; moreover meritorious nobles made requests, seeking day and night—Dun governed all by principle, above and below without resentment, and his governance ranked first under Heaven.

units.zh: 特加賞異，圖形於闕，詔頒天下。
units.en: He received special reward and distinction; his likeness was painted at the palace gate and an edict distributed it throughout the realm.
units.literal: He received special reward and distinction; his likeness was painted at the palace gate and an edict distributed it throughout the realm.

units.zh: 遷魏尹，出拜齊州刺史，轉梁州刺史，治並有聲。
units.en: He was moved to metropolitan magistrate of Wei, went out and received appointment as inspector of Qi province, transferred to inspector of Liang province—wherever he governed there was reputation.
units.literal: He was moved to metropolitan magistrate of Wei, went out and received appointment as inspector of Qi province, transferred to inspector of Liang province—wherever he governed there was reputation.

units.zh: 遷大司農。
units.en: He was moved to grand director of agriculture.
units.literal: He was moved to grand director of agriculture.

units.zh: 會侯景背叛，王思政入據潁城，王師出討，惇常督漕，軍無乏絕。
units.en: It happened that Hou Jing rebelled; Wang Sizheng entered and held Ying city; the royal army went out to attack; Dun constantly supervised transport, and the army never lacked supplies.
units.literal: It happened that Hou Jing rebelled; Wang Sizheng entered and held Ying city; the royal army went out to attack; Dun constantly supervised transport, and the army never lacked supplies.

units.zh: 引洧水灌城，惇之策也。
units.en: Drawing the Wei River to flood the city was also Dun's stratagem.
units.literal: Drawing the Wei River to flood the city was also Dun's stratagem.

units.zh: 遷殿中尚書。
units.en: He was moved to director in the palace ministry.
units.literal: He was moved to director in the palace ministry.

units.zh: 惇美鬚髯，下垂至帶，省中號為長鬛公。
units.en: Dun had a fine beard hanging down to his belt; within the ministry he was called the Long-Beard Lord.
units.literal: Dun had a fine beard hanging down to his belt; within the ministry he was called the Long-Beard Lord.

units.zh: 顯祖嘗因酒酣，握惇鬚髯稱美，遂以刀截之，唯留一握。
units.en: Gao Yang once, when drunk with wine, grasped Dun's beard and praised it, then took a knife and cut it off, leaving only one handful.
units.literal: Gao Yang once, when drunk with wine, grasped Dun's beard and praised it, then took a knife and cut it off, leaving only one handful.

units.zh: 惇懼，因不復敢長，時人又號為齊鬚公。
units.en: Dun was afraid and therefore no longer dared let it grow long; men of the time again called him the Trimmed-Beard Lord.
units.literal: Dun was afraid and therefore no longer dared let it grow long; men of the time again called him the Trimmed-Beard Lord.

units.zh: 世祖踐祚，領御史中丞，為膠州刺史。
units.en: When Gao Zhan ascended the throne, he concurrently served as Palace Aide to the Censor-in-Chief and became Inspector of Jiao Province.
units.literal: When Gao Zhan ascended the throne, he concurrently served as Palace Aide to the Censor-in-Chief and became Inspector of Jiao Province.

units.zh: 尋追為司農卿，又遷大理卿，再為度支尚書，歷太子少保、少師、光祿大夫、開府儀同三司、尚書右僕射、特進，賜爵萬年縣子，食下邳郡幹。
units.en: Soon he was recalled as director of the ministry of agriculture, again moved to director of the great court of justice, again director of the revenue ministry, and served in succession as junior guardian and junior tutor of the heir apparent, grand master of gleaming fortune, acting insignia equal to the three excellencies, right vice director of the masters of writing, and specially advanced; he was enfeoffed as baron of Wannian county with dry fief salary from Xiapi commandery.
units.literal: Soon he was recalled as director of the ministry of agriculture, again moved to director of the great court of justice, again director of the revenue ministry, and served in succession as junior guardian and junior tutor of the heir apparent, grand master of gleaming fortune, acting insignia equal to the Three Excellencies, right vice director of the masters of writing, and specially advanced; he was enfeoffed as Baron of Wannian county with dry fief salary from Xiapi commandery.

units.zh: 以年老致仕於家，三年卒。
units.en: Because of old age he retired to his home and died three years later.
units.literal: Because of old age he retired to his home and died three years later.

units.zh: 惇少純直，晚更浮動。
units.en: Dun in youth was pure and upright; in later years he became more restless.
units.literal: Dun in youth was pure and upright; in later years he became more restless.

units.zh: 齊朝體式，本州大中正以京官為之。
units.en: In Qi court practice the great impartial selector of the native commandery was held by a capital official.
units.literal: In Qi court practice the great impartial selector of the native commandery was held by a capital official.

units.zh: 同郡邢卲為中書監，德望甚高，惇與卲競中正，遂馮附宋欽道，出卲為刺史，朝議甚鄙薄之。
units.en: Xing Shao of the same commandery was supervisor of the secretariat; his virtue and standing were very high; Dun competed with Shao for the impartial selector post and therefore clung to Song Qindao, having Shao sent out as inspector; court opinion greatly despised him for it.
units.literal: Xing Shao of the same commandery was supervisor of the secretariat; his virtue and standing were very high; Dun competed with Shao for the impartial selector post and therefore clung to Song Qindao, having Shao sent out as inspector; court opinion greatly despised him for it.

units.zh: 雖久處朝行，歷官清顯，與邢卲、魏收、陽休之、崔劼、徐之才之徒比肩同列，諸人或談說經史，或吟詠詩賦，更相嘲戲，欣笑滿堂，惇不解劇談，又無學術，或竟坐杜口，或隱几而睡，深為勝流所輕。
units.en: Though he long walked the court ranks and held clear, eminent offices, standing shoulder to shoulder with Xing Shao, Wei Shou, Yang Xiuzhi, Cui Jie, Xu Zhicai, and the like—some discussed the classics and histories, some chanted poetry and rhapsodies, mocking one another in turn with laughter filling the hall—Dun did not understand lively talk and had no learning; sometimes he sat the whole time with sealed lips, sometimes hid behind a desk and slept, and was deeply slighted by the leading circles.
units.literal: Though he long walked the court ranks and held clear, eminent offices, standing shoulder to shoulder with Xing Shao, Wei Shou, Yang Xiuzhi, Cui Jie, Xu Zhicai, and the like—some discussed the classics and histories, some chanted poetry and rhapsodies, mocking one another in turn with laughter filling the hall—Dun did not understand lively talk and had no learning; sometimes he sat the whole time with sealed lips, sometimes hid behind a desk and slept, and was deeply slighted by the leading circles.

units.zh: 子文紀，武平末度支郎中。
units.en: His son Wenji, at the end of Wuping, was gentleman in the revenue ministry.
units.literal: His son Wenji, at the end of Wuping, was gentleman in the revenue ministry.

units.zh: 文紀弟文經，勤學方雅，身無擇行，口無戲言。
units.en: Wenji's younger brother Wenjing was diligent in study, square and refined in manner, with irreproachable personal conduct and no jesting words on his lips.
units.literal: Wenji's younger brother Wenjing was diligent in study, square and refined in manner, with irreproachable personal conduct and no jesting words on his lips.

units.zh: 武平末，殿中侍御史。
units.en: At the end of Wuping he was attendant censor within the palace.
units.literal: At the end of Wuping he was attendant censor within the palace.

units.zh: 隋開皇初，侍御史，兼通直散騎常侍，聘陳使副，主爵侍郎。
units.en: Early in Sui Kaihuang he was attendant censor, concurrently regular attendant for direct communication, deputy on embassy to Chen, and director of the ministry of enfeoffments.
units.literal: Early in Sui Kaihuang he was attendant censor, concurrently regular attendant for direct communication, deputy on embassy to Chen, and director of the ministry of enfeoffments.

units.zh: 卒於相州長史。
units.en: He died as chief of staff in Xiang province.
units.literal: He died as chief of staff in Xiang province.

units.zh: 惇兄遜，字仲讓，有幹局，乾明中平原太守，卒贈信州刺史。
units.en: Dun's elder brother Xun, styled Zhongrang, had administrative talent; in the Qianming era he was administrator of Pingyuan and on death was posthumously given inspector of Xin province.
units.literal: Dun's elder brother Xun, styled Zhongrang, had administrative talent; in the Qianming era he was administrator of Pingyuan and on death was posthumously given inspector of Xin province.

units.zh: 遜子文高，司徒掾。
units.en: Xun's son Wengao was a staff member in the ministry of the masses.
units.literal: Xun's son Wengao was a staff member in the ministry of the masses.

units.zh: 羊烈，字信卿，太山鉅平人也。
units.en: Yang Lie, styled Xinqing, came from Juping in Mount Tai.
units.literal: Yang Lie, styled Xinqing, was a man of Juping in Mount Tai.

units.zh: 晉太仆卿琇之八世孫，魏梁州刺史祉之弟子。
units.en: Eighth-generation descendant of Xiu, grand master of the imperial stud in Jin; nephew of Zhi, Liang inspector.
units.literal: Eighth-generation descendant of Xiu, grand master of the imperial stud in Jin; nephew of Zhi, Liang inspector.

units.zh: 父靈珍，魏兗州別駕。
units.en: His father Lingzhen was Wei vice-director in Yan province.
units.literal: His father Lingzhen was Wei vice-director in Yan province.

units.zh: 烈少通敏，自修立，有成人之風。
units.en: Lie from youth was penetrating and quick, self-cultivating in conduct, with the bearing of a mature man.
units.literal: Lie from youth was penetrating and quick, self-cultivating in conduct, with the bearing of a mature man.

units.zh: 好讀書，能言名理，以玄學知名。
units.en: Fond of reading books, able to discourse on essential principles, he was known for Dark Learning.
units.literal: Fond of reading books, able to discourse on essential principles, he was known for Dark Learning.

units.zh: 魏孝昌中，烈從兄侃為太守，據郡起兵外叛。
units.en: In the Wei Xiaochang era Lie's elder cousin Kan was administrator and, holding the commandery, raised troops in external rebellion.
units.literal: In the Wei Xiaochang era Lie's elder cousin Kan was administrator and, holding the commandery, raised troops in external rebellion.

units.zh: 烈潛知其謀，深懼家禍，與從兄廣平太守惇馳赴洛陽告難。
units.en: Lie had already seen through the scheme. Dreading ruin for his clan, he and his elder cousin Dun, governor of Guangping, raced to Luoyang to raise the alarm.
units.literal: Lie had secretly learned of the plot, feared disaster for his house, and with his elder cousin Dun, governor of Guangping, galloped to Luoyang to report the danger.

units.zh: 朝廷將加厚賞，烈告人云：「譬如斬手全軀，所存者大爾，豈有幸從兄之敗以為己利乎？」
units.en: The court meant to heap rewards on him. Lie told others, "It is like cutting off a hand to save the body—what remains is the greater part. How could I profit from a cousin's fall?"
units.literal: The court was about to heap rewards on him. Lie told others, "It is like cutting off the hand to save the body—what is preserved is the greater part. How could one take profit from a cousin's fall?"

units.zh: 卒無所受。
units.en: In the end he took nothing.
units.literal: In the end he accepted nothing.

units.zh: 弱冠，州辟主簿，又兼治中從事。
units.en: At weak cap the province summoned him as chief clerk; he also served concurrently as supervisory aide.
units.literal: At weak cap he was summoned as the province's chief clerk and also concurrently served as supervisory aide.

units.zh: 刺史方以吏事為意，以幹濟見知。
units.en: The prefect cared only for paperwork; Lie won notice for getting things done.
units.literal: The prefect cared only for clerical affairs; Lie was known for practical efficiency.

units.zh: 釋巾太師咸陽王行參軍，遷秘書郎。
units.en: He left private life for a staff post under Grand Tutor Prince of Xianyang, then rose to secretariat gentleman.
units.literal: He doffed the headcloth and became a staff officer under Grand Tutor Prince of Xianyang, then was promoted to secretariat gentleman.

units.zh: 顯祖初，為儀同三司開府倉曹參軍事。
units.en: When Xianzu came to power he was grain-supply staff officer in a third-rank opening office.
units.literal: At the start of Xianzu's reign he was grain-supply staff officer in an establishment of the third rank that opened the government.

units.zh: 天保初，授太子步兵校尉、輕車將軍，尋遷幷省比部郎中，除司徒屬，頻歷尚書祠部、左右民郎中，所在咸為稱職。
units.en: At the opening of Tianbao he was colonel of foot soldiers for the heir apparent and general of the light chariots, soon moved to merged-bureau director in the revenue section, then attendant of the Secretariat, and on through director of temple observances and the left and right people sections—every post he held earned the same verdict: competent.
units.literal: At the start of Tianbao he was made Colonel of the Foot Soldiers for the Heir Apparent and General of the Light Chariots, soon moved to merged-bureau director in the revenue section, made attendant of the Secretariat, and passed through director of temple observances and director in the left and right people sections—wherever he served he was called competent.

units.zh: 九年，除陽平太守，治有能名。
units.en: In the ninth year he was made governor of Yangping, and his rule won a name for ability.
units.literal: In the ninth year he was made governor of Yangping; his administration won a name for ability.

units.zh: 是時，頻有災蝗，犬牙不入陽平境，勑書褒美焉。
units.en: Locusts ravaged the land year after year, yet their teeth never crossed into Yangping; an edict praised him for it.
units.literal: At that time locust plagues came often; they did not cross the border into Yangping, and an edict praised him.

units.zh: 皇建二年，遷光祿少卿，加龍驤將軍、兗州大中正，又進號平南將軍。
units.en: In Huangjian's second year he was moved to vice director of the imperial household, given the dragon cavalry general's rank and the grand rectifier's post in Yan province, then advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.
units.literal: In the second year of Huangjian he was moved to vice director of the Imperial Household, given additional rank as General of the Dragon Cavalry and grand rectifier of Yan province, and further advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.

units.zh: 天統中，除太中大夫，兼光祿少卿。
units.en: In Tiantong he was made grand master of splendid happiness while keeping the vice directorship of the imperial household.
units.literal: In the Tiantong era he was made grand master of splendid happiness and concurrently vice director of the Imperial Household.

units.zh: 武平初，除驃騎將軍、義州刺史，尋以老疾還鄉。
units.en: At the start of Wuping he was made general of the valiant cavalry and governor of Yi province; before long age and illness sent him home.
units.literal: At the start of Wuping he was made General of the Valiant Cavalry and governor of Yi province; soon, on account of age and illness, he returned home.

units.zh: 周大象中卒。
units.en: He died in the Zhou Elephant reign.
units.literal: In the Zhou Elephant era he died.

units.zh: 烈家傳素業，閨門修飾，為世所稱。
units.en: The Lie line had long kept its proper craft; their inner gates were kept in order, and the age praised them for it.
units.literal: The Lie household had long transmitted its proper craft; inner gates were kept in order, and the age praised them.

units.zh: 一門女不再醮。
units.en: In that household no widow ever married again.
units.literal: In one household no woman married twice.

units.zh: 魏太和中，於兗州造一尼寺，女寡居無子者並出家為尼，咸存戒行。
units.en: In Wei Taihe they built a nunnery in Yan province; widows without sons all took the tonsure and kept the precepts.
units.literal: In the Wei Taihe era they built a nunnery in Yan province; women who were widowed and childless all took the tonsure as nuns and kept the precepts.

units.zh: 烈天統中與尚書畢義雲爭兗州大中正，義雲盛稱門閥，云「我累世本州刺史，卿世為我家故吏。」
units.en: During Tiantong, Lie disputed with Bi Yiyun, Minister of the Secretariat, over the post of Grand Rectifier of Yan Province. Yiyun greatly boasted of his family standing, saying, "For generations my family have been inspectors of this province, and for generations you have been old subordinates of my house."
units.literal: During Tiantong, Lie disputed with Bi Yiyun, Minister of the Secretariat, over the post of Grand Rectifier of Yan Province. Yiyun greatly boasted of his family standing, saying, "For generations my family have been inspectors of this province, and for generations you have been old subordinates of my house."

units.zh: 烈答云：「卿自畢軌被誅以還，寂無人物，近日刺史，皆是疆場之上，彼此而得，何足為言。
units.en: Lie answered, "Since your Bi Gui was executed, your line has been empty of anyone worth naming. The recent governors were all frontier men who seized the post by turns—what is there to boast of?
units.literal: Lie answered, "Since your Bi Gui was executed, your line has been empty of men worth naming. The recent governors were all men who won their posts on the frontier, each snatching the other by turns—what is there to boast of?

units.zh: 豈若我漢之河南尹，晉之太傅，名德學行，百代傳美。
units.en: How does that compare with our Han Governor of Henan and our Jin Grand Tutor—name, virtue, learning, and conduct handed down in beauty for a hundred generations?
units.literal: How can that compare with our Han Governor of Henan and our Jin Grand Tutor—name, virtue, learning, and conduct handed down in beauty for a hundred generations?

units.zh: 且男清女貞，足以相冠，自外多可稱也。」
units.en: Our men are pure and our women chaste—enough to crown the rest; beyond that there is much else to praise."
units.literal: Moreover our men are pure and our women chaste—enough to crown the rest; beyond that there is much else to praise."

units.zh: 蓋譏義雲之帷薄焉。
units.en: He meant it as a jab at the lax curtains in Yiyun's household.
units.literal: This was meant to mock Yiyun's lax curtains.

units.zh: 祉子深，魏中書令。
units.en: Zhi's son Shen was Wei secretariat director.
units.literal: Zhi's son Shen was Wei secretariat director.

units.zh: 深子肅，以學尚知名，世宗大將軍府東閤祭酒。
units.en: Shen's son Su was known for scholarship; he was eastern-pavilion libationer in the great general's establishment of the heir apparent.
units.literal: Shen's son Su was known for scholarship and cultivation; he was eastern-pavilion libationer in the heir apparent's great general's establishment.

units.zh: 乾明初，冀州治中。
units.en: At the start of Qianming he was supervisory aide of Ji province.
units.literal: At the start of Qianming he was supervisory aide of Ji province.

units.zh: 趙郡王為巡省大使，肅以遲緩不任職解，朝議以肅無罪，尋復之。
units.en: When the Prince of Zhao commandery toured as inspection envoy, Su was dismissed for slowness and unfitness; court opinion held him guiltless, and he was soon restored.
units.literal: The Prince of Zhao commandery went out as touring inspection envoy; Su was dismissed for slowness and unfitness for office, but court opinion held him guiltless and he was soon restored.

units.zh: 天統初，遷南兗州長史。
units.en: At the start of Tiantong he was moved to chief aide of Southern Yan province.
units.literal: At the start of Tiantong he was moved to chief aide of Southern Yan province.

units.zh: 武平中，入文林館撰書，尋出為武德郡守。
units.en: In Wuping he entered the Wenlin Hall to compile books, then went out as governor of Wude commandery.
units.literal: In Wuping he entered the Wenlin Hall to compile books, then went out as governor of Wude commandery.

units.zh: 烈弟脩，有才幹，大寧中卒於尚書左丞。
units.en: Lie's younger brother Xiu had talent and drive; in Daning he died as left vice director in the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Lie's younger brother Xiu had talent and capacity; in Daning he died as left vice director in the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 子玄正，武平末將作丞。
units.en: His son Xuanzheng, at the end of Wuping, was director of palace construction.
units.literal: His son Xuanzheng, at the end of Wuping, was director of palace construction.

units.zh: 隋開皇中民部侍郎。
units.en: Under Sui Kaihuang he was vice minister of the people.
units.literal: Under Sui Kaihuang he was vice minister of the people.

units.zh: 卒於隴西郡贊治。
units.en: He died while serving as overseer of Longxi commandery.
units.literal: He died as overseer of Longxi commandery.

units.zh: 源彪，字文宗，西平樂都人也。
units.en: Yuan Biao, styled Wenzong, came from Ledu in Xiping.
units.literal: Yuan Biao, styled Wenzong, was a man of Ledu in Xiping.

units.zh: 父子恭，魏中書監、司空，文獻公。
units.en: His father Zigong had been Wei secretariat supervisor, Minister of Works, and Duke Wenxian.
units.literal: His father Zigong was Wei secretariat supervisor, Minister of Works, and Duke Wenxian.

units.zh: 文宗學涉機警，少有名譽。
units.en: Wenzong was learned, alert, and quick-witted; from youth he had a name for ability.
units.literal: Wenzong was learned, alert, and quick-witted; from youth he had a name for ability.

units.zh: 魏孝莊永安中，以父功賜爵臨潁縣伯，除員外散騎常侍。
units.en: In Emperor Xiaozhuang's Yong'an era, for his father's merit he was given the barony of Linying and made irregular-attendant cavalier attendant.
units.literal: In the Yong'an era of Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei, for his father's merit he was given the barony of Linying and made irregular-attendant cavalier attendant.

units.zh: 天平四年，涼州大中正。
units.en: In Tianping's fourth year he was grand rectifier of Liang province.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tianping he was grand rectifier of Liang province.

units.zh: 遭父憂去職。
units.en: When his father died he left office.
units.literal: On his father's death he left office.

units.zh: 武定初，服闋，吏部召領司徒記室，加平東將軍。
units.en: At the start of Wuding, when mourning ended, the Ministry summoned him to head the secretariat records office and gave him the additional rank General Who Pacifies the East.
units.literal: At the start of Wuding, when mourning ended, the Ministry of State Affairs summoned him to head the secretariat records office, with additional rank as General Who Pacifies the East.

units.zh: 世宗攝選，沙汰臺郎，以文宗為尚書祠部郎中，仍領記室。
units.en: When the heir apparent took charge of selection and terrace gentlemen were winnowed, Wenzong was made director of temple observances while still heading the records office.
units.literal: When the heir apparent took charge of selection, terrace gentlemen were winnowed; Wenzong was made director of temple observances in the Masters of Writing while still heading the records office.

units.zh: 轉太子洗馬。
units.en: He was moved to groom of the heir apparent.
units.literal: He was moved to groom of the heir apparent.

units.zh: 天保元年，除太子中舍人。
units.en: In Tianbao's first year he was made heir-apparent palace aide.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianbao he was made heir-apparent palace aide.

units.zh: 乾明初，出為范陽郡守。
units.en: At the start of Qianming he went out as governor of Fanyang commandery.
units.literal: At the start of Qianming he went out as governor of Fanyang commandery.

units.zh: 皇建二年，拜涇州刺史。
units.en: In Huangjian's second year he was made governor of Jing province.
units.literal: In the second year of Huangjian he was made governor of Jing province.

units.zh: 文宗以恩信待物，甚得邊境之和，為鄰人所欽服，前政被抄掠者，多得放還。
units.en: Wenzong treated people with favor and trust and won deep harmony on the frontier; neighbors admired him, and many captives taken under earlier rule he secured and sent home.
units.literal: Wenzong treated people with favor and trust and won great harmony on the frontier; neighbors admired him, and many whom earlier administrations had carried off in raids he secured and sent home.

units.zh: 天統初，入為吏部郎中，遷御史中丞，典選如故。
units.en: At the start of Tiantong he entered court as director in the civil service section, then imperial censor, still overseeing selection as before.
units.literal: At the start of Tiantong he entered court as director in the civil service section, was moved to imperial censor, and still oversaw selection as before.

units.zh: 尋除散騎常侍，仍攝吏部，加驃騎大將軍。
units.en: Soon he was regular-attendant cavalier attendant while still running the civil service section, with the additional rank general of the valiant cavalry.
units.literal: Soon he was made regular-attendant cavalier attendant while still acting in the civil service section, with additional rank as General of the Valiant Cavalry.

units.zh: 屬秦州刺史宋嵩卒，朝廷以州在邊垂，以文宗往蒞涇州，頗著聲績，除秦州刺史，乘傳之府，特給後部鼓吹。
units.en: When Song Song, governor of Qin, died, the court judged the province a frontier post; Wenzong's record at Jing had been strong, so he was made governor of Qin, rode post relay to the seat, and was specially granted rear escort music.
units.literal: When Qin province's governor Song Song died, the court held that the province lay on the frontier; because Wenzong's tenure at Jing had won a strong reputation, he was made governor of Qin, traveled by post relay to the prefectural seat, and was specially granted rear escort music.

units.zh: 文宗為治如在涇州時。
units.en: Wenzong governed Qin as he had governed Jing.
units.literal: Wenzong governed as he had at Jing.

units.zh: 李孝貞聘陳，陳主謂孝貞曰：「齊朝還遣源涇州來瓜步，真可謂和通矣。」
units.en: Li Xiaozhen went on embassy to Chen; the Chen ruler told him, "Qi has again sent Governor Yuan of Jing to Guabu—surely that is harmony in full."
units.literal: Li Xiaozhen was sent on a mission to Chen; the Chen ruler told Xiaozhen, "Qi has again sent Governor Yuan of Jing to Guabu—truly this is harmony in full."

units.zh: 尋加儀同三司。
units.en: Soon he was given the additional rank establishment of the third rank.
units.literal: Soon he was given additional rank as establishment of the third rank.

units.zh: 武平二年，徵領國子祭酒。
units.en: In Wuping's second year he was summoned to head the Directorate of the Sons of the State.
units.literal: In the second year of Wuping he was summoned to head the Directorate of the Sons of the State.

units.zh: 三年，遷秘書監。
units.en: In the third year he was moved to secretariat supervisor.
units.literal: In the third year he was moved to secretariat supervisor.

units.zh: 陳將吳明徹寇淮南，歷陽、瓜步相尋失守。
units.en: Chen's general Wu Mingche invaded Huainan; Liyang and Guabu fell one after another.
units.literal: Chen's general Wu Mingche invaded Huainan; Liyang and Guabu fell in succession.

units.zh: 趙彥深於起居省密訪文宗曰：「吳賊侏張，遂至於此，僕妨賢旣久，憂懼交深，今者之勢，計將安出？
units.en: Zhao Yanshen, in private at the Office for Imperial Progress, asked Wenzong, "Wu the bandit swells and has come to this. I have long stood in the way of better men and live in worry and fear. What plan will serve today's situation?
units.literal: Zhao Yanshen, in private at the Office for Imperial Progress, secretly asked Wenzong, "Wu the bandit swells and has come to this. I have long blocked the worthy and am torn by worry and fear. In today's situation, what plan will do?

units.zh: 弟往在涇州，甚悉江淮間情事，今將何以禦之？」
units.en: You once governed Jing and know the Huai and Jiang country well—how will you defend against them now?"
units.literal: When you were at Jing you knew the Huai and Jiang country well—how will you defend against them now?"

units.zh: 對曰：「荷國厚恩，無由報效，有所聞見，敢不盡言。
units.en: He answered, "I owe the state deep favor and have no way to repay it; what I have seen and heard I dare not hold back.
units.literal: He answered, "I owe the state deep favor and have no way to repay it; what I have seen and heard I dare not hold back.

units.zh: 但朝廷精兵必不肯多付諸將，數千已下，復不得與吳楚爭鋒，命將出軍，反為彼餌。
units.en: But the court will never give its crack troops in large numbers to field commanders; a few thousand at most cannot stand against Wu and Chu. To send generals out is only to feed the enemy.
units.literal: But the court's crack troops will surely not be given in large numbers to the generals; a few thousand at most cannot contend with Wu and Chu. Sending generals out will only feed the enemy.

units.zh: 尉破胡人品，王之所知。
units.en: Your Majesty already knows Wei Pohu's character.
units.literal: Wei Pohu's character Your Majesty already knows.

units.zh: 進旣不得，退又未可，敗績之事，匪朝伊夕。
units.en: He cannot advance with success; he cannot retreat in safety; defeat is not a matter of mornings and evenings.
units.literal: Advance he cannot achieve; retreat he cannot take; defeat is not a matter of mornings and evenings.

units.zh: 王出而能入，朝野傾心，脫一日參差，悔無所及。
units.en: If Your Majesty goes out and can come in again, court and country will lean on you; if one day things go awry, there will be no place left for regret.
units.literal: If Your Majesty goes out and can come in again, court and country will lean on you; if one day things go awry, regret will have no place to stand.

units.zh: 以今日之計，不可再三。
units.en: On today's plan there must be no third try.
units.literal: On today's plan there must be no third try.

units.zh: 國家待遇淮南，失之同於蒿箭。
units.en: The state's treatment of Huainan has failed it like a mere arrow of wormwood.
units.literal: The state's treatment of Huainan has failed it like a mere arrow of wormwood.

units.zh: 如文宗計者，不過專委王琳，淮南招募三四萬人，風俗相通，能得死力，兼領舊將淮北捉兵，足堪固守。
units.en: By Wenzong's reckoning nothing surpasses putting everything in Wang Lin's hands: recruit thirty or forty thousand men in Huainan—customs match, they will fight to the death—and let him also command the old officers' north-of-the-Huai draft troops; that is enough to hold firm.
units.literal: By Wenzong's reckoning nothing surpasses entrusting Wang Lin alone: recruit thirty or forty thousand men in Huainan—customs match, they will fight to the death—and let him also command the old officers' north-of-the-Huai draft troops; that is enough to hold firm.

units.zh: 且琳之於曇頊，不肯北面事之明矣，竊謂計之上者。
units.en: Moreover Lin toward Chen's Xuandi plainly will not bow north and serve him—I venture this is the plan above all plans.
units.literal: Moreover Lin toward Xuandi of Chen plainly will not bow north and serve him—this, I venture, is the plan above all plans.

units.zh: 若不推赤心於琳，別遣餘人掣肘，復成速禍，彌不可為。」
units.en: If you do not give Lin your open heart but send others to check him, you will again bring swift disaster—still less can that be done."
units.literal: If you do not give Lin your open heart but send others to check him, you will again bring swift disaster—still less can that be done."

units.zh: 彥深歎曰：「弟此良圖，足為制勝千里，但口舌爭來十日，已不見從。
units.en: Yanshen sighed and said, "Brother, this fine plan would win a thousand li away—but tongues have argued for ten days already and no one will follow it.
units.literal: Yanshen sighed and said, "Brother, this fine plan would win a thousand li away—but the tongue has argued for ten days already and no one will follow it.

units.zh: 時事至此，安可盡言！」
units.en: The times have come to this—how can everything be spoken!"
units.literal: The times have come to this—how can everything be spoken!"

units.zh: 因相顧流涕。
units.en: Thereupon they looked at each other and wept.
units.literal: Thereupon they looked at each other and wept.

units.zh: 武平七年，周武平齊，與陽休之、袁聿修等十八人同勑入京，授儀同大將軍、司成下大夫。
units.en: In Wuping's seventh year, when Zhou pacified Qi, he was issued an edict into the capital with Yang Xiuzhi, Yuan Yuxiu, and eighteen others, and made general of the establishment of the same rank and junior mentor in the Directorate of the Sons of the State.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Wuping, when Zhou pacified Qi, together with Yang Xiuzhi, Yuan Yuxiu, and eighteen others he was issued an edict into the capital, made General of the Establishment of the Same Rank and junior mentor in the Directorate of the Sons of the State.

units.zh: 隋開皇初，授莒州刺史，至州，遇疾去官。
units.en: At the start of Sui Kaihuang he was made governor of Ju province; on reaching the province he fell ill and left office.
units.literal: At the start of Sui Kaihuang he was made governor of Ju province; on reaching the province he fell ill and left office.

units.zh: 開皇六年卒，年六十六。
units.en: In Kaihuang's sixth year he died, at sixty-six.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Kaihuang he died, aged sixty-six.

units.zh: 文宗以貴遊子弟升朝列，才識敏贍，以幹局見知。
units.en: Wenzong rose through the court ranks as a young man of noble houses, quick in talent and insight and known for practical capacity.
units.literal: Wenzong, as a young man of noble houses who rose in the court ranks, was quick in talent and insight and known for practical capacity.

units.zh: 然好遊詣貴要之門，故時論以為善於附會。
units.en: Yet he loved to visit the gates of the powerful, so opinion of the time held that he was skilled at currying favor.
units.literal: Yet he loved to visit the gates of the powerful and influential, so opinion of the time held that he was skilled at currying favor.

units.zh: 子師，少好學，明辨有識悟，尤以吏事知名。
units.en: His son Shi from youth loved learning, was clear in judgment and keen in understanding, and was especially known for clerical affairs.
units.literal: His son Shi from youth loved learning, was clear in judgment and keen in understanding, and was especially known for clerical affairs.

units.zh: 河清初，司空參軍事，歷侍御史、太常丞、尚書左外兵郎中。
units.en: At the start of Heqing he was staff officer in the Ministry of Works, then passed through attendant censor, director in the Grand Imperial Sacrifices, and director in the left outer military section.
units.literal: At the start of Heqing he was staff officer in the Ministry of Works, and passed through attendant censor, director in the Grand Imperial Sacrifices, and director in the left outer military section of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 隋開皇中，尚書比部、考功侍郎。
units.en: Under Sui Kaihuang he was director in the revenue section and vice director of merit assessment.
units.literal: Under Sui Kaihuang he was director in the revenue section and vice director of merit assessment.

units.zh: 大業初，卒於大理少卿。
units.en: Early in Daye he died as vice minister of justice.
units.literal: Early in Daye he died as vice minister of justice.

units.zh: 文宗弟文舉，亦有才幹，歷尚書比部、二千石郎中、定州長史，帶中山郡守。
units.en: Wenzong's younger brother Wenju also had talent and capacity; he passed through director in the revenue section, director of the two-thousand-bushel section, and chief aide of Ding province while concurrently governing Zhongshan commandery.
units.literal: Wenzong's younger brother Wenju also had talent and capacity; he passed through director in the revenue section, director of the two-thousand-bushel section, and chief aide of Ding province while concurrently governing Zhongshan commandery.

units.zh: 卒於太尉長史。
units.en: He died as chief aide of the Grand Commandant.
units.literal: He died as chief aide of the Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 文宗從父兄楷，字那延，有器幹，善草隸書。
units.en: Wenzong's elder cousin Kai, styled Nayian, had capacity and drive and was skilled in cursive and clerical script.
units.literal: Wenzong's elder cousin by the father's line Kai, styled Nayian, had capacity and drive and was skilled in cursive and clerical script.

units.zh: 歷尚書左民部郎中、治書侍御史、長樂中山郡守、京畿長史、黃門郎、假儀同三司。
units.en: He passed through director in the left people section, investigating censor, governor of Changle and Zhongshan, metropolitan chief aide, gate gentleman, and acting establishment of the third rank.
units.literal: He passed through director in the left people section of the Masters of Writing, investigating censor, governor of Changle and Zhongshan commanderies, metropolitan chief aide, gate gentleman, and acting establishment of the third rank.

units.zh: 齊滅，朝貴知名入周京者：度支尚書元脩伯，魏文成皇帝之後，清素寡欲，明識理體。
units.en: When Qi fell, eminent men known by name who entered the Zhou capital included Yuan Xiubo, Minister of Revenue, a descendant of Emperor Wencheng of Wei—pure, sparing in desire, clear in grasp of principle and form.
units.literal: When Qi fell, eminent men of the court known by name who entered the Zhou capital included Yuan Xiubo, Minister of Revenue, a descendant of Emperor Wencheng of Wei—pure, sparing in desire, clear in grasp of principle and form.

units.zh: 少歷顯職，尚書郎、治書侍御史、司徒左長史、數郡太守、光州刺史，所在皆著聲績。
units.en: From youth he passed through eminent posts—gentleman in the Masters of Writing, investigating censor, left chief aide of the Secretariat, several commandery governorships, and governor of Guang—and wherever he served won a name for achievement.
units.literal: From youth he passed through eminent posts—gentleman in the Masters of Writing, investigating censor, left chief aide of the Secretariat, several commandery governors, and governor of Guang province—and wherever he served won a name for achievement.

units.zh: 及為度支，屬政荒國蹙，儲藏虛竭，賦役繁興。
units.en: When he became Minister of Revenue, government was wasteful and the state narrow; storehouses stood empty and levies and corvée multiplied.
units.literal: When he became Minister of Revenue, government was wasteful and the state narrow; storehouses were empty and levies and corvée multiplied.

units.zh: 脩伯憂國如家，恤民之勞，兼濟時事，詢謀宰相，朝夕孜孜，與錄尚書唐邕廻換取捨，頗有裨益。
units.en: Xiubo grieved for the state as for his own house, pitied the people's labor, and together aided the affairs of the time; morning and evening he sought counsel from the chancellor with tireless zeal, and with Recorder Tang Yong exchanged views on what to take and what to leave—quite to the good.
units.literal: Xiubo grieved for the state as for his own house, pitied the people's labor, and together aided the affairs of the time; he sought counsel from the chancellor morning and evening with tireless zeal, and with Recorder of the Masters of Writing Tang Yong exchanged views on what to take and what to leave—quite to the good.

units.zh: 周朝授儀同大將軍、載師大夫。
units.en: The Zhou court made him general of the establishment of the same rank and grand master of the Zai shi.
units.literal: The Zhou court made him General of the Establishment of the Same Rank and Grand Master of the Zai shi.

units.zh: 其事行史闕，故不列於傳。
units.en: His deeds are missing from the histories, so he is not given a biography here.
units.literal: His deeds are missing from the histories, so he is not listed in a biography.

units.zh: 齊末又有幷省尚書隴西辛愨、散騎常侍長樂潘子義並以才幹知名。
units.en: At the end of Qi there were also Xin Que of Longxi, merged-bureau director in the Masters of Writing, and Pan Ziyi of Changle, regular-attendant cavalier attendant—both known for talent and capacity.
units.literal: At the end of Qi there were also Xin Que of Longxi, director in the merged-bureau Masters of Writing, and Pan Ziyi of Changle, regular-attendant cavalier attendant—both known for talent and capacity.

units.zh: 入仕周、隋，位歷通顯云。
units.en: They entered service under Zhou and Sui and rose to eminent posts, it is said.
units.literal: They entered service under Zhou and Sui and rose to eminent posts, it is said.

units.zh: 論曰：李稚廉等以材能器幹，所在咸著聲名。
units.en: The historiographer writes: Li Zhilian and the others, by talent and capacity, won fame wherever they served.
units.literal: The historiographer says: Li Zhilian and the others, by talent and capacity, won fame wherever they served.

units.zh: 封述聚積財賄，敝於鄙吝，季良以學淺為累，文宗以附會見稱。
units.en: Feng Shu amassed wealth and was worn down by stinginess; Xu Dun, styled Jiliang, was held back by shallow learning; Wenzong was praised for currying favor.
units.literal: Feng Shu amassed wealth and was worn down by stinginess; Jiliang was held back by shallow learning; Wenzong was praised for currying favor.

units.zh: 然則羊、李二賢足為具美，士人君子，可不慎與！
units.en: Yet the two worthies Yang and Li were complete in virtue—gentlemen, should they not take care!
units.literal: Yet the two worthies Yang and Li were complete in virtue—gentlemen, should they not take care!

units.zh: 贊曰：惟茲數賢，幹事貞固。
units.en: Praise: Only these several worthies—work steadfast and firm.
units.literal: Praise: Only these several worthies—work steadfast and firm.

units.zh: 生被雌黃，歿存縑素。
units.en: In life touched by censure, in death preserved in silk.
units.literal: In life touched by censure, in death preserved in silk.

units.zh: 封及源、許，終為身蠹。
units.en: Feng and Yuan, Xu—ended as worms in their own flesh.
units.literal: Feng and Yuan, Xu—ended as worms in their own flesh.

units.zh: 壬寅，魏帝詔太原公洋攝理軍國，遣中使敦喻。
units.en: On renyin day the emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang administer military and state affairs and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.
units.literal: On renyin the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Yang administer military and state affairs, and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.

units.zh: 時太原公洋在城東雙堂，入而討賊，臠割京等，皆漆其頭。
units.en: At the time Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.
units.literal: At the time Prince of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.

units.zh: 丙戌，以兼尚書右僕射趙彥深為左僕射。
units.en: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Vice Director Zhao Yanshen was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Deputy Director Zhao Yanshen was appointed Left Deputy Director.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 魏主將出避顥，未知所之，或勸之長安，中書舍人高道穆曰：「關中荒殘，何可復往！
units.en: The Wei emperor was about to flee before Hao and did not know where to turn; some urged Chang'an. The Secretariat Drafter Gao Daomu said, "Guanzhong lies in ruins—how can we go back there!
units.literal: The Wei ruler was about to leave to avoid Hao and did not know where to go; some urged Chang'an. The Secretariat Drafter Gao Daomu said: "Guanzhong is wasted and ruined—how can we go there again!

units.zh: 甲戌，魏主北行，夜，至河內郡北，命高道穆於燭下作詔書數十紙，佈告遠近。
units.en: On jiaxu the Wei emperor marched north; that night he reached the north of Henei commandery and ordered Gao Daomu by lamplight to draft dozens of edicts and proclaim them far and wide.
units.literal: On day jiaxu the Wei ruler went north; at night he reached the north of Henei commandery and ordered Gao Daomu by candlelight to draft several dozen edicts and proclaim them far and near.

units.zh: 顥士眾不多，乘虛深入，由將帥不得其人，故能至此。
units.en: Hao's troops are not numerous; they have pierced this deep only because our commanders are unfit—that is why they stand here.
units.literal: Hao's soldiers are not numerous; penetrating deeply on a gap is only because the commanders are unworthy, and that is why they have come this far.

units.zh: 陛下若親帥宿衛，高募重賞，背城一戰，臣等竭其死力，破顥孤軍必矣。
units.en: If Your Majesty personally leads the palace guard, posts lavish bounties, and fights one battle with the wall at your back, we will spend our lives to the last man and surely break Hao's isolated army.
units.literal: If Your Majesty personally leads the palace guard, offers high rewards at great cost, and fights one battle with your back to the wall, we your servants will spend our lives, and Hao's lone army will surely be broken.

units.zh: 或恐勝負難期，則車賀不若渡河，征大將軍天穆、大丞相榮各使引兵來會，犄角進討，旬月之間，必見成功。
units.en: If the outcome is hard to foresee, better to cross the river in state: summon the grand general Tianmu and the grand chancellor Rong, have each bring his host, and close in from two sides—in ten days or a month success will show.
units.literal: Or, if victory and defeat are hard to foresee, then it is better to take the imperial carriage and cross the river, summon the Grand General Tianmu and the Grand Chancellor Rong each to bring troops to join, and advance in pincers—within ten days or a month success will appear.

units.zh: 此萬全之策也。」
units.en: That is the plan without flaw."
units.literal: This is the plan of complete safety."

units.zh: 孝昭皇帝演，字延安，神武皇帝第六子，文宣皇帝之母弟也。
units.en: Emperor Xiaozhao, whose personal name was Yan and style name Yan'an, was the sixth son of Emperor Shenwu and the full younger brother of Emperor Wenxuan.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaozhao Yan, styled Yan'an, was the sixth son of Emperor Shenwu and the younger brother of Emperor Wenxuan by the same mother.

units.zh: 大寧元年閏十二月癸卯，梓宮還鄴，上諡曰孝昭皇帝。
units.en: In the intercalary twelfth month of Daning 1, on guimao, his coffin was returned to Ye, and he was given the posthumous title Emperor Xiaozhao.
units.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month of the first year of Daning, on guimao, the imperial coffin returned to Ye, and the posthumous title Emperor Xiaozhao was presented.

units.zh: 魏元象元年，封常山郡公。
units.en: In the first year of the Yuanxiang era of Wei, he was made Duke of Changshan Commandery.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang of Wei, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Changshan Commandery.

units.zh: 唯常山王至，內外肅然。
units.en: Only when the Prince of Changshan appeared did the palace fall silent and straighten itself.
units.literal: Only when the Prince of Changshan arrived would inside and outside become solemn and awestruck.

units.zh: 皇建元年八月壬午，皇帝即位於晉陽宣德殿，大赦，改乾明元年為皇建。
units.en: On the renwu day of the eighth month of the first year of Huangjian, the emperor ascended the throne in the Xuande Hall at Jinyang, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name from Qianming to Huangjian.
units.literal: On the renwu day of the eighth month of Huangjian year 1, the emperor ascended the throne in the Xuande Hall at Jinyang, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name from Qianming year 1 to Huangjian.

units.zh: 五年，除幷省尚書令。
units.en: In the fifth year he was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat for the combined provinces.
units.literal: In the fifth year, he was appointed Chief Minister of the Secretariat of the Joint Provinces.

units.zh: 八年，轉司空、錄尚書事。
units.en: In the eighth year he was made Minister of Works and Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat.
units.literal: In the eighth year, he was transferred to Minister of Works and made Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 帝長於政術，剖斷咸盡其理，文宣歎重之。
units.en: The prince had a gift for statecraft; every ruling he handed down went to the heart of the matter, and Emperor Wenxuan marveled at him.
units.literal: The Emperor excelled in the art of governance; his analyses and judgments all exhaustively addressed the principles involved, and Wenxuan sighed in admiration and held him in high esteem.

units.zh: 幼而英特，早有大成之量，武明皇太后早所愛重。
units.en: Even as a boy he was remarkable, showing early promise of greatness, and Empress Dowager Wuming had cherished him from the start.
units.literal: From childhood he was outstanding; early on he showed the measure of great accomplishment, and Empress Dowager Wuming had loved and esteemed him from the first.

units.zh: 及文襄執政，遣中書侍郎李同軌就霸府為諸弟師。
units.en: Once Wenxiang took charge of the government, he dispatched Li Tonggui, Gentleman of the Secretariat, to the Overlord's residence to instruct his younger brothers.
units.literal: When Wenxiang came to hold power, he sent Secretariat Gentleman Li Tonggui to the Overlord's residence to serve as tutor to the younger brothers.

units.zh: 右丞相、長廣王湛研機測化，體道居宗，人雄之望，海內瞻仰，同胞共氣，家國所憑，可遣尚書左僕射、趙郡王叡喻旨，征王統茲大寶。
units.en: Prince Zhan of Changguang, right chancellor, understands hidden workings and change, embodies the Way, and stands foremost among the clan. The whole realm looks to him as a hero among men. Born of the same mother and sharing the same breath, he is the support of house and state. Send Prince Rui of Zhaojun, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, to convey my intent and summon him to take charge of the throne.
units.literal: The Right Chancellor, Prince Zhan of Changguang, studies subtle workings and fathoms transformation, embodies the Way and stands within the clan; as a hero among men, he is looked up to within the seas. Of the same womb and shared breath, he is one on whom house and state rely. The Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince Rui of Zhaojun, may be sent to explain the intent and summon the prince to govern this great treasure.

units.zh: 順成后本魏朝宗室，文宣欲帝離之，陰為帝廣求淑媛，望移其寵。
units.en: Empress Shuncheng came from the Wei imperial clan. Emperor Wenxuan wanted the prince to turn from her and secretly searched out worthy beauties for him, hoping to draw his heart elsewhere.
units.literal: Empress Shuncheng was originally of the imperial clan of Wei; Wenxuan wanted the Emperor to distance himself from her, and secretly sought fine ladies widely for the Emperor, hoping to shift his favor.

units.zh: 冬十一月辛亥，立妃元氏為皇后，世子百年為皇太子。
units.en: On the xinhai day of the eleventh month, Consort Yuan was installed as empress and the heir apparent Gao Bainian as crown prince.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the xinhai day, Consort Yuan was installed as empress and the heir apparent Bainian as crown prince.

units.zh: 豈幽顯之間，實有報復，將齊之基宇止在於斯，帝欲大之，天不許也？
units.en: Was there retribution at work between the seen and unseen worlds—and was the Northern Qi destined to rise no higher? He sought to expand its domain, but Heaven would not allow it.
units.literal: Was it that between the hidden and the manifest there is truly retribution, and that the foundation of Qi would extend no further—he wished to enlarge it, but Heaven would not permit it?

units.zh: 天保初，進爵為王。
units.en: At the opening of the Tianbao era, he was raised to princely rank.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, his rank was advanced to prince.

units.zh: 九年，除大司馬，仍錄尚書。
units.en: In the ninth year he was made Grand Marshal while retaining his post as Recorder of the Secretariat.
units.literal: In the ninth year, he was appointed Grand Marshal, while still serving as Recorder of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 及文宣崩，帝居禁中護喪事，幼主即位，乃即朝班。
units.en: When Emperor Wenxuan died, Xiaozhao remained in the palace to oversee the funeral. Once the young ruler took the throne, he entered the court ranks.
units.literal: When Wenxuan died, the emperor remained inside the palace to oversee the funeral arrangements; after the young ruler ascended the throne, he then took his place in the court ranks.

units.zh: 除太傅、錄尚書，朝政皆決於帝。
units.en: He was appointed grand tutor and recorder of the Masters of Writing, and all court affairs were decided by him.
units.literal: He was appointed Grand Tutor and Recorder of the Masters of Writing, and all court government was decided by the emperor.

units.zh: 時楊愔、燕子獻、可朱渾天和、宋欽道、鄭子默等以帝威望旣重，內懼權逼，請以帝為太師、司州牧、錄尚書事；
units.en: At the time Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Kezhuhun Tianhe, Song Qindao, Zheng Zimo, and the others saw how great his prestige had become and secretly feared the pressure of his authority. They asked that he be made grand preceptor, governor of Sizhou, and recorder of the Masters of Writing;
units.literal: At the time Yang Yin, Yanzi Xian, Kezhuhun Tianhe, Song Qindao, Zheng Zimo, and others, because the emperor’s prestige had become weighty and they inwardly feared the pressure of his power, requested that he be made Grand Preceptor, governor of Sizhou, and Recorder of the Masters of Writing;

units.zh: 詔以帝為大丞相、都督中外諸軍、錄尚書事，相府佐史進位一等。
units.en: An edict appointed him Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of all armies at home and abroad, and Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat, and all staff of the chancellery were promoted one rank.
units.literal: An edict appointed the Emperor Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of all armies at home and abroad, and Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat; assistants and clerks of the chancellery were promoted one rank.

units.zh: 先是帝不豫而無闕聽覽，是月，崩於晉陽宮，時年二十七。
units.en: Before this the emperor had been ill, yet he had not neglected audiences or reviews of affairs. That month he died in Jinyang Palace at the age of twenty-seven.
units.literal: Before this, the emperor had been ill but had not neglected hearings and review; that month he died in Jinyang Palace, aged twenty-seven.

units.zh: 庚午，葬於文靖陵。
units.en: On gengwu he was buried in Wenjing Mausoleum.
units.literal: On gengwu, he was buried in Wenjing Mausoleum.

units.zh: 身長八尺，腰帶十圍，儀望風表，迥然獨秀。
units.en: He stood eight feet tall, with a waist ten spans around; in bearing and presence he stood apart, towering above all others.
units.literal: He stood eight feet tall, with a waist ten spans around; in bearing and appearance he stood alone, towering above others.

units.zh: 帝聰敏有識度，深沉能斷，不可窺測。
units.en: The emperor was quick-witted and far-sighted, deep and decisive—his inner thoughts could not be read.
units.literal: The emperor was keen and perceptive, with breadth of judgment; deep and resolute, he could not be fathomed.

units.zh: 澤率爾對曰：「陛下聰明至公，自可遠侔古昔，而有識之士，咸言傷細，帝王之度，頗為未弘。」
units.en: Pei Ze answered without hesitation: "Your Majesty is intelligent and utterly fair and could indeed rival the sages of antiquity, but men of discernment all say you are too exacting in small matters—the magnanimity proper to an emperor is still somewhat lacking."
units.literal: Ze answered straight off: "Your Majesty is intelligent and utterly fair and could indeed rival the ancients of old, but men of discernment all say you are too exacting in small matters; the magnanimity proper to an emperor is still somewhat lacking."

units.zh: 帝又密撰事條，將諫，其友王晞以為不可。
units.en: The prince secretly drew up a list of grievances and prepared to remonstrate, but his friend Wang Xi urged him not to.
units.literal: The Emperor also secretly drafted a list of matters and was about to remonstrate; his friend Wang Xi thought it inadvisable.

units.zh: 先是禁友王晞，乃捨之，令侍帝。
units.en: Wang Xi, his friend, had earlier been placed under restriction; now Emperor Wenxuan freed him and set him to wait on the prince.
units.literal: Earlier Wang Xi, his friend, had been confined; now he released him and ordered him to attend the Emperor.

units.zh: 同軌病卒，又命開府長流參軍刁柔代之，性嚴褊，不適誘訓之宜，中被遣出。
units.en: After Tonggui died of illness, Diao Rou, a senior staff officer in the chief's office, was appointed in his place—but Diao was harsh and rigid, ill suited to teaching, and before long was dismissed.
